warnings.message: Yarn Classic (1.x) is not supported; nothing written for it
warnings.fix: Move to Yarn (Berry) 4.10.2 or later, or to another package manager depcurfew configures

warnings.message: npm: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for npm 12.2.1, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (packageManager, devEngines, .tool-versions or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: npm: npx, npm exec and npm x pick the version of a package they download with the release-age delay alone and do not read min-release-age-exclude, so they still hold new versions of @acme/* and left-pad back for cooldown.minimum
warnings.fix: Install such a package with npm install, which reads min-release-age-exclude, and run it from node_modules/.bin: npx runs it from there without downloading it

warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: pnpm: onlyBuiltDependencies takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: pnpm 10.0.0 does not support minimumReleaseAge (added in 10.16.0), blockExoticSubdeps (added in 10.26.0); not written
warnings.fix: Require pnpm 10.26.0 or later where the version is pinned
